name: AR-9
description:
## Description

"This is a large tall boy speaker system of the vertical series designed with sufficient consideration for high-output power amplifier.Two 30-cm cone woofers are placed on both sides of the enclosure and a crossover frequency of 200Hz eliminates the wall-dip phenomenon that occurs between the speaker and the back wall.It is equipped with 20cm cone type units for the middle and low band, 3.8cm dome type units for the middle and high band, and 1.9cm dome type units for the high band.The mid - and low-range units are mounted in subenclosures to prevent internal interference.In addition, a magnetic colloidal magnetic flux developed by NASA is inserted between the voice coil and yoke of the mid-range and high-range units to reduce distortion and improve input resistance with a structure that does not deviate from the central axis.The network section is equipped with an electronic automatic transmission originally developed for low-frequency use.Like the mission of an automatic car, this system automatically controls the low-frequency characteristics electrically. It operates so that the damping is maximized at the resonance frequency without reducing the low-frequency output. For the portion exceeding the resonance frequency, it is switched electrically so that the flat characteristics are maintained even if the signal exceeds the bus spectrum.In addition, a 17AWG air-core coil, a computer-grade electrolytic capacitor, and a high input resistance ceramic resistor are used as elements.The AR traditional acoustic suspension system is used for the enclosure.In this system, the air acts as a spring by completely sealing the inside, and compliance can be increased, and low-frequency resonance frequency can be made lower.An acoustic blanket, a special sound-absorbing material, is installed around the driver unit to prevent deterioration of sound quality due to reflected sound.It is finished with walnut oil."

"This hightech series floor-type speaker system inherits the technology of the Vertical Series.Two 20cm cone type woofers are installed in the lower range.The woofer units are secured to both sides of the enclosure, an arrangement inherited from the AR9reference model that protects against the wall dip that floor speakers often experience. It provides the unique low-distortion bass of dual woofer independent of the sound reflected from the floor.The mid-range is equipped with a 20cm cone type mid-range.A sub-enclosure is mounted inside the enclosure to prevent mutual interference with the woofer unit.A 3.2cm dome type tweeter is installed in the high range.By injecting a magnetic fluid between the pole piece and yoke, the power handling capability is improved. This magnetic fluid guides the voice coil naturally to the center axis of the pole piece, improving the accuracy of the unit and enabling playback with less distortion. The magnetic fluid is a mixture of colloidal binder and fine metal particles, and the fluid moves according to the strength of the magnetic field.In addition, an acoustic blanket is attached around the tweeter to absorb middle and high sound coming around the edge of the enclosure and to suppress the irregular reflection of sound.A 17AWG air-core coil and an electrolytic capacitor are used in the network section.The enclosure is made of high-density particle board material with black mold finish on the top panel and legs, and a black net with excellent acoustic transparency on the side including the front baffle.The inner system uses the traditional acoustic suspension system, and the air inside the fully enclosed enclosure acts as a spring to support the cone to improve bass reproduction."
